'''Kunor Bann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[44 ABY]], Bann developed a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] brought on by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], causing him to believe that everyone he knew had been replaced by impostors. He succumbed to the psychosis while inside the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], although he was captured by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] there and confined in the [[Jedi Temple detention center]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] drew up a report that went into detail about the psychosis in Bann and another Jedi who was suffering from the same illness, [[Turi Altamik]], putting forth her belief that the rate of Jedi succumbing to the psychosis was accelerating. Before long, however, [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] successfully completed [[Mission to the Maw|his mission]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Abeloth, resulting in the immediate termination of Bann's psychosis.

Bann later participated in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue attempt]] to free both [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] from the clutches of [[Galactic Alliance Security]]. As part of "Team Saav'etu", Bann took up a defensive position outside the bunker housing the Horn siblings and helped fend off attacks by GAS personnel.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
